description: Treating pressure held in iron, manifolds, and the tree; energy release on a failed union, cut-out, or improper bleed-down.
control: Pressure test before pumping; bleed down and verify zero before breaking any connection; stay outside the red zone while pumping.

description: The path an iron run, hose, or wing nut takes if it fails under pressure.
control: Restraints and whip checks on iron; exclusion zone around lines during pumping; no crossing of pressurized iron.

description: Hammer union wing nuts, valve handwheels, actuator linkages, and crane loads.
control: Hands clear during make-up; sledge use per procedure; tag lines on suspended loads.

description: Perforating guns, setting tool power charges, and detonators.
control: Radio silence and RF-safe systems; licensed personnel; magazines and day boxes; no personnel in front of loaded guns.

description: Proppant dust at silos, boxes, conveyors, and the blender.
control: Enclosed transfer systems, dust suppression, monitoring, respiratory protection where required.

description: Sour gas at flowback and on some wells during wireline and drillout.
control: Monitors, wind indicators, breathing apparatus per site plan.

description: Lubricator sections, injector heads, and tree components lifted over the well.
control: Certified lifting gear, exclusion below suspended loads, tag lines.

description: Electric fleets, VFD houses, and switchgear at high voltage.
control: Arc-flash boundaries, lockout, qualified personnel only.

description: Proppant-laden flow erodes gates, seats, iron elbows, and swivels, leading to a loss of containment.
control: Tree saver in the wellhead, iron inspection and wall-thickness tracking, valves fully open or fully closed only.
